limits: Fixed pressure uses durable actors and a projectile floor with fixed 1/60 simulation; it is not natural real-delta FPS.
Native live runs consume actual frame deltas and evolve into different battles. Large changes between runs prevent strict causal FPS attribution.
All tests use an offscreen native window. Foreground and other hardware/driver behavior can differ.
Other Godot processes were present and were preserved. This task did not run its own performance tests concurrently with each other, checks or exports.
P95/P99 aggregates above are the mean of per-run percentiles, not pooled percentiles.

53 latest unique suites pass; an earlier supplemental input scene failed due invalid native offscreen pointer coordinates, including in baseline. The test fixture was corrected and its direction assertion strengthened; production input was not changed.
resolved_test_failures: Rig reuse originally enumerated the appendage batch alongside bones. Binding now selects actual Bone2D nodes with anchor metadata.
Rig cache boundary fixture uses lightweight mock nodes; those conservatively retain the original disposal path.
Input scene uses a real SubViewport and explicit local event injection so desktop cursor coordinates cannot corrupt the input fixture.
source_hash_scope: Files changed by this optimization and its tests; unrelated workspace updates were preserved. The delivered EXE is the immutable binary used in the final comparisons.
